fields.description: Do not block: only a recorded failure stops a student registering, and a prerequisite with no result is reported on the row instead. Choose this while results predate the system, or every student is blocked from everything. Treat as not passed: a prerequisite with no result blocks, which is only correct once every result a student needs is recorded here.
fields.label: When a prerequisite has no result on record
fields.options:
Do not block
Treat as not passed

fields.description: Refuse registration to a student who owes money. The balance is the outstanding total on their submitted Sales Invoices; with no invoices raised the balance is zero and nobody is blocked.
fields.label: Outstanding Fees Block Registration

fields.description: Balances at or below this are ignored, so a student owing a few rand is not turned away.
fields.label: Tolerance

fields.description: Shown to the student as the second step of registration. Amending the wording does not alter consents already recorded, which keep their own copy.
fields.label: Registration Declarations
